---

## Problem

Describe the problem or limitation you are running into.
A clear statement such as "I am trying to do X but I cannot because Y" helps
maintainers understand the context.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature or change you would like to see. Be as specific as you can.
If you have considered alternative approaches, mention them too.

## Alternatives Considered

List any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered and why they
are insufficient.

## Additional Context

Screenshots, links to similar features in other tools, or any other context
that would help evaluate this request.
